gamebox.games.snake.name: Snake
gamebox.games.snake.description: Classic snake game: eat food, grow, and avoid crashing.
gamebox.games.snake.howto:
Guide the snake with WASD or the arrow keys.
Eat apples to grow and score points.
Avoid hitting the walls, yourself, or
TNT obstacles (Hard/Expert only).

SPACE pauses or resumes the game.
After Game Over, SPACE starts a new run.

Higher difficulties use a smaller board,
a faster snake, and more obstacles.
gamebox.games.lights_out.name: Lights Out
gamebox.games.lights_out.description: Turn off every light. Clicking a cell toggles it and its neighbors.
gamebox.games.lights_out.howto:
The goal is to turn OFF every light on the board.

Clicking a cell toggles it AND its up/down/
left/right neighbors (not diagonals).

Every puzzle is generated to be solvable -
there's always a way to clear it.

Higher difficulties use a bigger board and
start from a more scrambled state.
gamebox.games.minesweeper.name: Minesweeper
gamebox.games.minesweeper.description: Clear the board without detonating a mine. Left-click to reveal, right-click to flag.
gamebox.games.minesweeper.howto:
Left-click a cell to reveal it.
A number shows how many mines are in the
8 surrounding cells. Zero means the area
is safe and opens up automatically.

Right-click a hidden cell to flag it as a
suspected mine.

Left-click an already-revealed number to
'chord': if you've flagged exactly that many
mines around it, the rest of its neighbors
reveal at once. Wrong flags can still explode!

Win by revealing every cell that isn't a mine.
gamebox.games.sudoku.name: Sudoku
gamebox.games.sudoku.description: Fill the grid so every row, column, and 3x3 box contains 1-9 exactly once.
gamebox.games.sudoku.howto:
Fill every cell so that each row, column,
and 3x3 box contains the digits 1-9
with no repeats.

Click a cell to select it, then press a
number key (1-9) to fill it in.
Backspace/Delete clears it.

Toggle 'Notes' to pencil in small candidate
numbers instead of a final answer - handy
for tracking possibilities in a cell.

Conflicting numbers are highlighted in red.
gamebox.games.memory.name: Memory
gamebox.games.memory.description: Flip two cards at a time and find every matching pair.
gamebox.games.memory.howto:
Click a card to flip it face up.

Flip a second card: if they match, both
stay face up. If not, the next click you
make will flip both back face down.

Find all the matching pairs to win.
Fewer moves and less time make for a
better score.
gamebox.games.game2048.description: Slide numbered tiles to combine matching values and reach 2048.
gamebox.games.game2048.howto:
Use WASD or the arrow keys to slide every
tile in one direction at once.

When two tiles with the same number touch,
they merge into one tile with double the
value, adding to your score.

A new tile (2 or 4) appears after every
move that changes the board.

The game ends when the board is full and
no more merges are possible. Try to reach
2048 - and beyond, if you can keep going!
gamebox.games.simon.name: Simon
gamebox.games.simon.description: Watch the color sequence, then repeat it back. Each round adds one more color.
gamebox.games.simon.howto:
Watch the colors light up in sequence,
then click them back in the same order.

Each time you repeat a round correctly,
one more color is added to the sequence
and it plays again from the start.

One wrong click ends the game. Your score
is the number of rounds you completed.

Higher difficulties flash faster and
pause less between colors.
gamebox.games.mastermind.name: Mastermind
gamebox.games.mastermind.description: Guess the secret color code before you run out of attempts.
gamebox.games.mastermind.howto:
The game picks a secret code of colors.
Your job is to guess it.

Click colors in the palette to fill your
guess (click a filled slot to clear it),
then press Submit.

After each guess, every peg gets a colored
frame:
- GREEN frame: right color, right position.
- ORANGE frame: right color, wrong position.
- GRAY frame: that color isn't in the code.

Hard and Expert may repeat colors in the
secret code, and use longer codes with more
available colors. Guess it correctly before
you run out of attempts to win.
gamebox.games.mastermind.lost_detail: Out of attempts - secret revealed below
gamebox.games.game1010.name: 10x10
gamebox.games.game1010.description: Fit blocks into a 10x10 grid. Clear full rows and columns before you run out of space.
gamebox.games.game1010.howto:
You have 3 pieces to place on a 10x10
board, in any order you like.

Click a piece below the board to select it,
then click a spot on the board to place it.
Green means it fits there, red means it
doesn't.

Completing a row or column (fully filled,
no gaps) clears it and gives bonus points.

Once all 3 pieces are used, a fresh set of
3 appears. The game ends when none of your
current pieces fit anywhere on the board.
gamebox.games.flappy_bird.name: Flappy Bird
gamebox.games.flappy_bird.description: Flap through the gaps between pipes without hitting anything.
gamebox.games.flappy_bird.howto:
Click anywhere on the screen, or press
SPACE, to make the bird flap upward.

Gravity constantly pulls the bird down -
keep flapping to stay airborne and guide it
through the gaps between the green pipes.

Hitting a pipe, the ceiling, or the ground
ends the game. You score a point for every
pipe you successfully pass.

After Game Over, click or press SPACE
again to start a new run.
gamebox.games.flappy_bird.restart_hint: Click or press SPACE to try again
